sn22.80:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme || || 2
sn22.80:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā kismiñcid eva pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇāmetvā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacivaram ādāya Kapilavathuṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi || || 3
sn22.80:1.3: Kapilavatthusmiṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapatikkanto yena mahāvanaṃ tenupasaṅkami divāviharāya ||
sn22.80:1.4: mahāvanam ajjhogahetvā veluvalaṭṭhitāya mūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi || || 4
sn22.80:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || || 5
sn22.80:2.3: santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ||
sn22.80:2.4: tesaṃ mamaṃ apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo || ||
sn22.80:2.5: Seyyathāpi nāma vacchassa taruṇassa mātaraṃ apassantassa siyā aññathattam siyā vipariṇāmo || || 6
sn22.80:2.6: Evam evaṃ santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ tesaṃ mamaṃ apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo || ||
sn22.80:2.7: Seyyathāpi nāma bījānam taruṇānaṃ udakam alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattam siyā vipariṇāmo || || 7
sn22.80:2.9: tesaṃ mamaṃ alabhantānaṃ dassanāya siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo || ||
sn22.80:2.10: Yaṃ nūnāhaṃ yatheva mayā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahīto evam eva etarahi anuggaṇheyyaṃ bhikkhusaṅghanti || || 8
sn22.80:3.1: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati Bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitam vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritam vā bāham sammiñjeyya || evam eva Brahmaloke antarahito Bhagavato purato pātur ahosi || || 9
sn22.80:3.2: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.80:3.3: Evam etam Bhagavā evam etaṃ Sugata
sn22.80:3.5: Santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ||
sn22.80:3.6: tesaṃ Bhagavantam apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo || ||
sn22.80:3.7: Seyyathāpi nāma vacchassa taruṇassa mātaram apassantassa siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo || || 11
sn22.80:3.8: Evam eva santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imam dhammavinayaṃ || tesaṃ Bhagavantam apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo || ||
sn22.80:3.9: Seyyathāpi nāma bījānam taruṇānaṃ udakaṃ alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo || || 12
sn22.80:3.10: Evam eva santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ || tesaṃ Bhagavantam alabhantānaṃ dassanāya siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo || || 13
sn22.80:3.13: yatheva bhante Bhagavatā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahito evam evaṃ etarahi anuggaṇhātu bhikkhusaṅghanti || || 14
sn22.80:4.2: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati Bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi || || 16
sn22.80:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yena Nigrodhārāmo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi
sn22.80:5.2: nisajja kho Bhagavā tathārūpam iddhābhisaṅkhāram abhisaṅkhāyi yāthā te bhikkhū [ekavihakāya sārajjāyamānarūpā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkameyyuṃ || 17
sn22.80:5.3: Te bhikkhū] ekavihakāya sārajjāyamānarupā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 11 Ekam antaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn22.80:6.1: Antam idaṃ bhikkhave jīvikānaṃ yad idaṃ piṇḍolyam ||
sn22.80:6.3: taṃ ca kho evaṃ bhikkhave kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā atthavasaṃ paṭicca ||
sn22.80:6.4: neva rājābhinītā na corābhinītā na iṇaṭṭhā na bhayaṭṭhā na jīvikā pakatā ||
sn22.80:6.5: Api ca kho otiṇṇamhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi || dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto ||
sn22.80:6.6: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antarakiriyā paññāyethāti || || 19
sn22.80:7.2: so ca hoti abhijjālu kāmesu tibbasārāgo vyāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo || ||
sn22.80:7.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave chavālātam ubhato padittam majjhe gūthagataṃ neva gāme kaṭṭhattam pharati nāraññe kaṭṭhattam pharati ||
sn22.80:7.4: tathūpamāham bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi gihibhogā ca parihīno sāmaññatthañca na paripūreti || || 20
sn22.80:8.3: ||ime ca kho bhikkhave tayo akusalavitakkā kva aparisesā nirujjhanti || ||
sn22.80:8.4: Catūsu vā satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhita-cittassa viharato animittaṃ vā samādhiṃ bhāvayato || || 21
sn22.80:8.5: Yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alam eva animitto samādhi bhāvetuṃ ||
sn22.80:8.6: animitto bhikkhave samādhi bhāvito bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso || || 22
sn22.80:9.3: Tatra kho bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn22.80:9.4: Atthi nu kho kiñci lokasmiṃ yam aham upādiyamāno na vajjavā assan ti || 23
sn22.80:9.6: Natthi nu kho taṃ kiñci lokasmiṃ yam aham upādiyamāno na vajjavā assam ||
sn22.80:9.7: ahaṃ hi rupaññeva upadiyamāno upādiyeyyaṃ || vedanaññeva ||
sn22.80:9.13: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo assa || || 24
sn22.80:10.2: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.80:10.4: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.80:10.6: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.80:10.7: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || ||
